rooms.title: The Cedars — Future Landscape Proposal
rooms.description: Future post-renovation concept, not the August 2025 opening condition. The Cedars remains a separate detached staff house with its own street entrance and enclosed private garden; proposed landscaping adds a kitchen garden, event lawn and controlled connection to Albury. Its garden is approximately 0.7 acre. At story opening it is empty and unconnected; an integrated capacity near 500 remains a future possibility, not an outdoor-only capacity.

rooms.title: Principal Kitchen & Breakfast Room
rooms.description: Approximately 900 square feet, Albury’s daily production kitchen is a room-scale professional residential workspace rather than a domestic kitchen enlarged with expensive appliances. The 24-foot working wing has a 22-foot cooking-and-appliance wall and one 15-by-5-foot stool-free island, with visibly clear five-foot aisles on every side. The island provides separated mise-en-place stations, refrigerated drawers, shallow tool storage, a narrow dry-goods pull-out, prep sink, integrated waste and power; the rear wall carries a 180 cm range and full-width extraction, while tall green joinery conceals combi-steam and conventional ovens, warming drawers, full-height refrigeration and freezer storage. The garden-facing breakfast table occupies its own bay six feet beyond the island.

rooms.title: Principal Kitchen — Brigade in Use
rooms.description: The generous circulation is operational rather than decorative: Rafael stands wholly within the range-side aisle, Tolly works from the island’s open right-hand aisle with both feet on the floor, and Élodie occupies the separate rear prep counter beyond it. No member of the brigade shares or intersects the island footprint. Dean Wilkes handles wash-up, reset and deliveries through the service route; the butler’s pantry receives the pass, and the event kitchen below adds capacity for larger catered service.

rooms.title: Principal Kitchen — Reverse Overview
rooms.description: Looking back from the breakfast bay confirms the full working volume: the single island remains centred with clear circulation, the long range wall runs opposite it, and the appliance bank, rear prep station and service passage remain distinct rather than collapsing into one crowded wall.

rooms.title: Principal Kitchen — Cooking Wall
rooms.description: The 180 cm black range, twin ovens, full-width extraction, brass pot filler and deep landing counters form Rafael’s primary hot line. The island edge remains far enough away to preserve the working aisle for a second cook to pass safely behind him.

rooms.title: Principal Kitchen — Island Workstation

rooms.title: Principal Kitchen — Appliance & Prep Zone
